pix.text: I have an essay due at nine and I've been in reels for three hours. Don't coach me, just tell me what to do.
Why would I use this and not just ask a regular chatbot?
Remember that I scroll when I'm anxious.

greet.text: Just so you know, I'm an AI, not a person. Adrienne here. What are you putting off?

b1.text: Stop scrolling. Open your document and write one paragraph.

b3.text: I'm for the moment you're stuck. Tell me what you're avoiding and I give you one tiny first step, start the clock with you, and wait through your pauses. When time's up I check in, and I remember what helped.

checkin.text: Did you open your document and start the first ninety seconds of setup?

b5.text: Great. Write one more sentence now.

b7.text: Glad it worked for you. Take care.
